explanation: In 2009 UNESCO recognized tango as shared heritage of Argentina and Uruguay. The famous tango 'La cumparsita' was written by a Uruguayan, Gerardo Matos Rodríguez.

claims.text: Tango developed in the Río de la Plata region, in Buenos Aires and Montevideo.
Tango did not grow up in Asunción, Santiago or Lima.
In 2009 UNESCO inscribed tango on its intangible cultural heritage list as a tradition of Argentina and Uruguay.
The tango La cumparsita was composed by the Uruguayan Gerardo Matos Rodríguez.
